description: This file contains functions for generating and managing career development roadmaps based on role and competency analysis. It includes functions for collecting requirements, computing gaps, generating recommendations, creating visual mind maps, and storing/retrieving roadmap data in a database.

classes.name: Roadmap
classes.description: A data model representing a career development roadmap, possibly including fields like session_id, role_from, role_to, payload, created_at.

methods.name: List[Tuple[Competency,int]] _collect_role_requirements(db: Session, role_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves competencies required for a specific role, including the required levels.

methods.name: int _current_level_for( db: Session, comp_id: int, *, session_id: Optional[str], user_id: Optional[int] )
methods.description: Determines a user's or session's current competency level.

methods.name: List[str] _deterministic_recommendations(category: str, name: str, gap: int)
methods.description: Generates a list of learning recommendations based on competency category and gap size.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _mind_map_from_gaps( role_from: Role, role_to: Role, gaps: List[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Creates a graph structure for visualizing gaps between current and target roles.

methods.name: Roadmap generate_roadmap( db: Session, *, role_from_id: int, role_to_id: int, session_id: Optional[str] = None, user_id: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive roadmap including gap analysis, recommendations, and visual mind map, then stores it in the database.

methods.name: List[Roadmap] list_roadmaps( db: Session, *, session_id: Optional[str] = None, user_id: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Lists all stored roadmaps filtered by session or user.

methods.name: Optional[Roadmap] get_roadmap(db: Session, roadmap_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific roadmap by its unique ID.
